description: Find the time zone and current local time in up to 10 cities by name ("Cebu", "São Paulo", "Springfield" + country). 7,000+ cities. Use for "what time is it in" questions and to get the IANA zone the other tools need. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

at.description: ISO 8601 instant to show local time for; default now

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (207 countries); its public holidays (2000–2050) are excluded from business days

name: city_time
title: City time zone and local time
